successCriteria.description: src/shared/types/leave.ts exports LeaveType enum with exactly three members: ANNUAL, SICK, EMERGENCY (string-valued)
src/shared/types/leave.ts exports LeaveRequestStatus enum with exactly five members: DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED (string-valued)
src/shared/types/leave.ts exports BalanceStatus enum with exactly three members: ACTIVE, EXHAUSTED, FROZEN (string-valued)
src/shared/types/index.ts barrel re-exports all three enums (LeaveType, LeaveRequestStatus, BalanceStatus) from ./leave
Jest unit tests in tests/unit/shared/types/ verify each enum has the correct members and correct member count

constraints: No dependencies on prior phases — this is the foundation phase; must not import from any module outside src/shared/types/
Enums must use string-valued members (e.g., ANNUAL = 'ANNUAL') for serialization safety across the REST boundary
Barrel index.ts must re-export from ./leave, not duplicate enum definitions
outOfScope: Additional LeaveType values (unpaid, maternity, paternity) mentioned in ARCHITECTURE.md — deferred to later phases
Database tables, migrations, repositories, services, controllers, routes — all deferred to Phases 2–10
State transition logic, validation, RBAC, audit — deferred to later phases
